title: SpaceX European prospectus describing Terafab
excerpt: SpaceX described a one-terawatt annual compute-production goal and an integrated Terafab workflow while expecting significant third-party compute sourcing to continue.
summary: The issuer prospectus supplies primary evidence for Terafab's intended scope, prospective status, continued third-party sourcing and non-definitive framework risks relevant to NVIDIA demand and substitution.
